items.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe

items.lede: 1Password says a hacker stole customer names and email addresses after gaining access to its backend systems. The breach didn't expose passwords or other information stored in customer vaults, but could put users at risk of phishing attempts, according to a post disclosing the incident. It's unclear how many users are affected. The password manager […]
